author: gpt-6
purpose: Authored editorial direction for 45 acts; dated design assessment, not a DelendAI verdict or complete mission contract.
limits: No new historical reading or chronological adjudication is claimed. Source qualification remains in canonical selections and consultation records.
No native map, measured difficulty, objective budgets or completed expanded dossier is supplied by an act card.
The architect owns unresolved episode decisions. MiniMax must not invent a solution to the constraints here.

acts.editorialIntent: Administrative fragments become a network making room for outsiders; belonging is not conquest.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Relocation carries acute pressure before the quieter assembly consequence.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Witness comparison, household provision and relocation require distinct predicates; do not rename the same delivery.

acts.editorialIntent: Work and correspondence build a network that must survive a local catastrophe.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Production and parallel consignments teach planning before the Roman evacuation; the next opening needs a readable reset.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Corinth production and Ephesus preservation need different resource/identity decisions. The fire is not player-caused.

acts.editorialIntent: Temple destruction changes conditions of transmission without producing uniform communities or texts.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Evacuation peaks early; later hospitality, comparison and an administrative question allow recovery without declaring disputes over.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not conflate this catastrophe with Nero’s Roman fire or infer authorship location from local text circulation.

acts.editorialIntent: Petition gives way to threatened witnesses and incomplete memory.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Lyon extraction is acute; later comparison and household aid show consequences without a second invented battle.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Carthage legal transmission differs from Sardes escort and Lyon witness comparison in objects, custodians and recovery.

acts.editorialIntent: Certificates and departures lead to qualified restitution within Miriam’s plausible lifetime.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Carthage evacuation precedes a restitution coda that does not imply universal peace.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Milan is a fictional local reception. Recommend the imperial successor with an explicit 313-to 312 chronology overlap.

acts.editorialIntent: Military success does not settle property restitution, African disputes or rival imperial authority.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Alternate river combat, property recovery and diplomatic logistics; end with a finite withdrawal.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Cibalae changes the problem. Neither victory nor the 313 agreement establishes an official state religion.

acts.editorialIntent: Land/strait victory concentrates authority while disagreement remains unresolved.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: After the strait operation, change to conflicting correspondence and council reception; the council peak is coordination.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Adrianople and Chrysopolis need distinct crossing/manifest problems. Antioch is a separate disputed preparatory council.

acts.editorialIntent: Patronage and a new capital cannot remove uncertainty, death or contested succession.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Alternate works, external dispatch and testimony; court transition peaks structurally before competing seals show aftermath.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The undated imperial letter must not acquire a composition date or Marcus as eyewitness from its place in the menu.

acts.editorialIntent: Repeated councils fail to produce lasting concord, and return can be followed by exile.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Alexandrian night withdrawal carries acute pressure; Rimini’s document network supplies an unresolved consequence.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Sardica separate receptions and Rimini drafts need different parties, objects and outcomes, not a common unanimous-council script.

acts.editorialIntent: Policy reversals and defeat lead through reassembly, law and changed urban access to a qualified conciliar coda.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Adrianople is the military low point; Sirmium adds bounded readiness, then law and care change the problem. Do not make every late episode another military peak.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Constantinople 380 still needs a distinct dossier. Alternative care recipes are not simultaneous fixed payments or evidence of played balance.

acts.editorialIntent: Temple loss opens a rupture followed by plural local practices and institutional uncertainty.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Peak at evacuation, then rebuild capacity through refuge, study and fiscal reconciliation.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Yavneh is not a certified universal canon council. Household reception, witness comparison and Roman fiscal work remain distinct.

acts.editorialIntent: Teaching, diaspora upheaval and revolt change which households and records can survive.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Build towards finite cave/archive extraction, then relocation acknowledges the defeat.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Cyrene and Alexandria keep their geography. Mint consignments and desert extraction are different operations, not repeated conquest maps.

acts.editorialIntent: Compilation, citizenship, workshops and schools cross different local environments.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Dura’s artisan/river problem changes scale between study networks; cross-river logistics opens a new horizon.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not substitute Pumbedita for Dura or claim a completed Babylonian Talmud. Keep texts, recipients and towns independently identified.

acts.editorialIntent: Mosaics, disputed violence, compilation and law coexist without one uniform policy.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Abortive works must allow safe withdrawal; legal reception and donor logistics supply different consequences.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not complete the Temple, equate law with uniform enforcement, or turn an inscription into a city blueprint.

acts.editorialIntent: Fiscal changes and restrictions alter authority while transmission continues.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Loss of privileges changes conditions; repair within restrictions and distributed preservation replace a last religious stand.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The 425 limit is editorial, not the end of Jewish history. Huqoq’s broad dating is not an exact construction day.

acts.editorialIntent: Rival episcopal claims and exile concern civic accountability, not inevitable universal supremacy.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Roman civilian extraction is acute; the Milan petition is a different consequence, with no conquest requirement.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Sardica and Rimini differ in delegation structure. Do not make a reported distant massacre a player objective.

acts.editorialIntent: Relief after a sack precedes changing Italian authorities and difficult court relations.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Start in crisis, then recover through administration and reconciliation before an unsafe embassy return.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not invent continuous war through the gaps; Ravenna’s banquet killing stays contextual, not rewarded play.

acts.editorialIntent: Occupation, siege, evacuation and repair lead to negotiation and an outward mission.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: A siege is followed by escape/rebuilding, finite payment and hospitality rather than a new mandatory siege.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Kent changes geography and recipients; it cannot replay the Roman convoy or put the whole Channel on one local map.

acts.editorialIntent: Buildings, council texts and exile expose limits to agreement between authorities.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Exile relief is the human constraint; material accounts and delegation work change response instead of adding enemy armies.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Building conversion, later bronze removal, council reception and image policy need different finite ledgers and historical scopes.

acts.editorialIntent: Frankish protection and conflict culminate in refuge, negotiation and an unresolved crowning.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Pavia carries siege pressure; Paderborn refuge is a late acute constraint before the ceremonial coda.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not settle later church/empire relations. Historical dignitaries remain contextual; controlled escorts and households are declared fiction.

acts.editorialIntent: Succession, councils, exile, education and law establish a changing eastern civic world.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Civilian refuge is an early pressure point; school works and compilation provide different recovery tasks.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Code and relics missions need different originals and reception.330 is recap, not an extra mission inside the 337 opening.

acts.editorialIntent: Disagreement, urban destruction, construction and disease strain separate cities differently.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Nika extraction and reconstruction precede finite care/food allocation; the council is an institutional coda, not another plague wave.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Care implies no miraculous cure or unimplemented disease model. Antioch 540 must not reuse Constantinople 532 terrain.

acts.editorialIntent: Sieges and changing regional authority require separate responses across large time jumps.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Distinguish 626 ferry defense, uncertain coastal watch and 717–718 winter supply; council logistics changes pace between them.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not certify a continuous 674–678 siege or make it succeed because a fictional local task did. Technology and transport need real support.

acts.editorialIntent: Image policy affects artisans and rival councils without uniform popular responses.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Workshop protection precedes constrained council logistics;787 changes work and reception, not everyone’s belief.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Hieria and Nicaea are not identical courier missions with reversed labels; no population has an innate religious personality.

acts.editorialIntent: Court changes, reversals and renewed image policy lead to a situated 843 restoration.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Pliska withdrawal peaks before refuge and workshop preservation; restoration is a coda with consequences, not total reconciliation.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The 800 Roman crowning reaches Anna as news. Pliska and Versinikia keep separate uncertain battlefield footprints.

acts.editorialIntent: Attributed traditions, migration preparations and reception lead to a new local community.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Provision/departure planning build to migration; arrival changes responsibilities rather than completing a conquest.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The two Aqaba selections remain access gaps and need different negotiations/reception problems, not duplicate fictional pledge deliveries.

acts.editorialIntent: Defense, reversals and agreements change the oasis community before disputed succession.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: The ditch is defensive pressure; truce logistics and civilian provision vary response before death/transition closes through care and testimony.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Uhud withdrawal, Khaybar extraction and Mecca provision need different entities/routes. No literal legendary hero feat becomes required play.

acts.editorialIntent: Regional allegiance, defeats and expansion create different obligations rather than an inevitable victory march.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Bridge failure creates recovery; later surrender, ravine supply and river crossing require different local decisions.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Yamama, Damascus, Qadesiya and Ctesiphon dates need qualified comparison; no table determines the whole sequence.

acts.editorialIntent: Surrender, settlement and administration expose local consequences of expansion.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Harbour withdrawal differs from a river camp; close in Medinan transition, without escalating peaceful Antioch into a war.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Separate Alexandria’s initial conquest from the later return; correct Kaegi’s locator and reject the Hormozan conflation.

acts.editorialIntent: Island expeditions and distant imperial change lead to an unresolved Medinan crisis.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Naval withdrawal is acute; household/records aftermath provides a sober change of perspective.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Cyprus 649 belongs here despite the current 651 heading; fleets, landing sites and 656 private motives remain unverified.

acts.editorialIntent: Opposition, killing and contested recognition alter how civilians and messages move.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: The murder stays off-map; refuge is acute before uncertain administration and rival petitions.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Reports, household extraction and testimony must change the player problem, not become three copy deliveries.

acts.editorialIntent: Basra moves from arrival through unrest/battle to distribution and a new political center.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Differentiate pre-battle extraction, field care and post-battle receipts; Kufa reception/reply provide recovery.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Before/during/after Basra need separate actors, starting states and recovery. Kufa is not a map stretching to Basra.

acts.editorialIntent: Fighting yields to a ceasefire whose terms and representation stay contested.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Battle/water peaks before disengagement; protocol and witness comparison lower military pressure while changing the cognitive problem.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Orders 12–16 cannot be five letter trips. Protocol needs reciprocal original parties; testimony needs independent evidence handling.

acts.editorialIntent: Secession, arbitration and territorial loss change the cost of sustaining a coalition.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Relocation/delegation precede finite civilian withdrawal; regional reports and rural relief vary consequences.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Harura, Dumat, Nahrawan, Egypt and Adhruh remain separate. Egypt 658 and Hijaz 660 are not a simultaneous battlefield.

acts.editorialIntent: Regional coercion reports precede leadership loss and a negotiated transfer.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Care/preservation around the loss is acute; supply, protocol and archives show consequences rather than reversing 661 in a last battle.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Farid does not witness private assassination planning. Recommend Umayyad or household perspective without declaring a moral victor.

acts.editorialIntent: Administration and succession receive reports of a distant tragedy.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Teach market/ledger choices, then change obligations through witness reception and relief; a short act does not require an invented battle.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Karbala stays off-map; no advantage comes from choosing victims, celebrating execution or proving a succession claim.

acts.editorialIntent: Repeated civil conflict changes property, authority, monument works and exchange.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Differentiate 683 relief from 692 property recovery. Mint reconciliation and a western harbour add other constraints.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The two Meccan sieges cannot repeat phases/enemy composition; works, mint and accounts are not conversion objectives.

acts.editorialIntent: Eastern campaigns involve contested entry, withdrawal, receipts and remote reports.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Paykand siege differs from Ramitin relief and Bukhara receipts; later messages create uncertainty rather than another larger assault.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not project a modern oasis plan, reward Nizak’s killing or turn Balkh into a map of every remote campaign.

acts.editorialIntent: Straits/eastern routes widen the horizon before failed siege and later local revolt.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Constantinople withdrawal is acute; Kufa refuge is a local consequence after an explicit time jump.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Samarkand property, Khwarazm trade, Bukhara works and caravan relief need different decision structures, not one generic siege.

acts.editorialIntent: Competing seals and revolutionary networks lead to river defeat and eastern dynastic loss.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Zab withdrawal peaks before record preservation and a final report; local success cannot reverse the defeat.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: The 750 end concerns eastern rule, not all Umayyads. Busir killing is contextual and never an assassination victory.

acts.editorialIntent: A child’s household perspective receives political news, violence and a new Kufan setting.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Basra care/withdrawal is acute; workshop/household reception changes scale before a remote Egyptian report.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Dina’s inheritance is not adult eyewitness memory; the Egyptian letter and Kufan workshop need different states and recipients.

acts.editorialIntent: River care gives way to contested terms and households choosing to leave.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Disengagement changes pressure after water/care; protocol, comparison and relocation show consequences.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Separate relief, disengagement and evidence. Fictional household rescue is not a substitute for a political settlement.

acts.editorialIntent: Conflict and leadership loss precede negotiation changing who governs.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Pair civilian withdrawal with later source comparison; obligations/distribution change stakes before a public-record coda.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Hasan negotiation, transfer and ceremony are not three treaty deliveries or a renunciation of religious identity.

acts.editorialIntent: Return and disputed memory give way to correspondence whose support is uncertain.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Distinct household, departure and reply problems precede extraction after Kufan arrests.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Do not conflate death reports, departure, letters and loss of support. Poisoning responsibility and private promises remain attributed.

acts.editorialIntent: Uncertain news closes roads before a tragedy local aid cannot reverse.
acts.pressureAndRecovery: Consignments, voluntary return, camp provision and messages lead to finite care/extraction with the documented outcome fixed.
acts.distinctnessRequirement: Three Karbala selections are not three battles. Do not save people whose death is documented or imply no survivors; fictional civilians remain distinct.
